Author: BlueWaveXIV
Name: AutoList
Description: AutoList turns retainer Market Board chores into supervised AutoList, AutoRefresh, and AutoTidy workflows with a small in-game tray that lights up when your character is ready to start.
Punchline: Turn retainer listing from market-board chore into one-click momentum.
Changelog:
AutoList now skips opening selected retainers during its active-listing scan when the live retainer list shows zero items for sale.
AutoTidy now records zero-sale retainers as empty without opening their market listings.
Updated the retainer-list reader to the current Dalamud string value name for warning-free release builds.
